scope: Johnson County Public Library digital training, business research, investment, and reference databases

records.name: Johnson County Public Library LearningExpress Library
records.description: Provides online practice tests, exam and certification preparation, career exploration, vocational guidance, résumé support, and academic-skills training through Johnson County Public Library.
records.availability_notes: Remote access generally requires an eligible JCPL library card or authorized student account. Platform content and authentication requirements may change. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Public Library AtoZdatabases
records.description: Business and consumer research database for finding companies, people, jobs, sales leads, mailing lists, new movers, homeowners, and audience segments by geography and demographic characteristics.
records.availability_notes: Access requires an eligible JCPL library card or authorized account. Database coverage, download limits, and acceptable-use rules should be checked before bulk list creation. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Public Library LinkedIn Learning for Library
records.description: Provides thousands of self-paced instructional courses in business, marketing, data analytics, software, Microsoft Office, Adobe tools, web design, programming, photography, and other professional skills.
records.availability_notes: Available at no cost to eligible JCPL district cardholders using a library card number and PIN; no personal LinkedIn profile is required. Course availability can change. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Public Library EBSCOhost Research Databases
records.description: Provides searchable full-text articles, journals, magazines, reports, and reference materials for business, education, workforce, community, and general research through JCPL and participating database services.
records.availability_notes: Specific EBSCO collections, full-text coverage, and authentication pathways vary. Use the JCPL databases page rather than a temporary login-session URL. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Public Library Value Line
records.description: Provides investment research, data, expert analysis, rankings, and commentary covering approximately 3,500 stocks, including small- and mid-cap companies.
records.availability_notes: JCPL notes a limit of four simultaneous users. Access requires an eligible library account, and the database is informational rather than personalized investment advice. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Public Library World Book Online
records.description: Provides online encyclopedias, reference articles, multimedia, learning tools, and general educational research materials for children, students, adults, families, and community learners.
records.availability_notes: Remote access requires an eligible JCPL library card or authorized account. Available modules and authentication requirements may change. Verified August 6, 2026.
